source: Successful prior deep neon salvagepunk candidate batches under assets/ai_candidates.
artDirection: deep space + industrial punk + salvagepunk machinery + deep neon sci-fi. Dark gunmetal and worn steel, carbon-black plating, exposed bolts, vents, mechanical seams, armored plates, subtle grime and scratches, cyan engine/neon glow, magenta plasma accent lines, amber cockpit/utility lights, and small red emergency lights where useful. Strong readable silhouettes, clean game-ready shapes, high contrast over a dark starfield after manual background removal. Not painterly noise, not generic clean sci-fi, not cartoon, not realistic photo, not franchise-inspired.
backgroundInstruction: Background: pure #FFFFFF white background for manual background removal. No checkerboard. No transparent-background preview. No gradient. No texture. No scene. No environmental lighting on the background. No drop shadow on the background. The asset must be isolated, centered, and clearly separated from the white background.
globalExclusions: No readable text unless explicitly requested.
No shadows that require a specific background.
No white glow, pale smoke, or light outer rim blending into the white background.

cameraRules.gameSprites: Strict top-down orthographic game sprite view, no cinematic perspective, no low-angle render, no angled product render, no horizon, no camera depth shift, no dramatic perspective foreshortening, forward-facing orientation when the asset has a front, readable silhouette at small size.
cameraRules.hud: Flat orthographic front view, no perspective, no transparent center unless explicitly requested, white background only outside the asset silhouette, usable panel interiors dark gray, gunmetal, dark glass, or appropriate in-world material, not white, no fake text, no labels, no icons unless the asset is specifically an icon sheet, 9-slice-friendly where possible.
